from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class DocumentEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document relevant to the task."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    applicable_causes: List[str] = Field(description="The specific legal case causes (案由) from the provided task list that apply to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted document information from the collection."""
    documents: List[DocumentEntry]
